document.title: PER-2/PJ/2024: Bentuk bukti potong dan SPT Masa PPh 21/26

delta.note: PER-2/PJ/2024 only governs the form and procedure for making PPh 21/26 withholding slips (bukti pemotongan) and the form, content, filling, and submission of the monthly SPT. It is purely administrative and reporting in nature. It does not change any rate, PTKP, deduction, table, rounding, or calculation step for permanent employees. The substantive rules come from PP 58/2023 and PMK 168/2023, which are cited only as legal basis.
